Subject: OrionCloud vendor onboarding: compliance checklist & initial PO info

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attaching our initial compliance matrix for Redwood to review — it contains the usual items (DPA options, SOC 2 pointer, subprocessor list). Quick questions to unblock procurement on our side:

- Do you require us to sign Redwood's DPA, or will Redwood execute OrionCloud's standard DPA?
- What PO cadence does Redwood prefer (we can accept net-30 or net-45; please confirm).
- Who should we direct the final invoice to for PO matching?

I've included a link to our SOC 2 report inside the attachment list and attached our latest matrix for easy reference.

Attachments: compliance_matrix.xlsx

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks,

Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrionCloud vendor onboarding: compliance checklist & initial PO info

Hi Emily — thanks for sending the matrix. Looping in Ben (procurement) and Marcus (finance) to confirm PO and payment terms. Next steps from our side: 

1) We typically ask vendors to sign Redwood's standard DPA; if OrionCloud prefers to use your DPA, legal will need to review any redlines. Please confirm which document you intend to sign.
2) For production vendors we default to Net-45, but Net-30 is possible for smaller deals — Ben, can you confirm for ORC-4721?
3) Please share the signed DPA and the authoritative subprocessor list (CSV preferred). Once we have those we can move to PO issuance.

For convenience here are the links/procedures we use: vendor-portal.redwood.com (PO submission) and finance@redwood.com for invoices. I'll create a tentative PO in our portal pending the signed DPA.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

Agree with Rachel. Quick internal notes:
- Net-45 is preferred for new vendors unless sales has negotiated otherwise — Rachel, mark ORC-4721 as Net-45.

- Marcus: can you confirm the PO creation path and whether we need a vendor W9/ACH form before issuing?
